title: UX-01 task 5: the Collection binder reference
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Reference fixture: 173 records-only selection entries (image: false) bring the fixture to all 242 Hyperia City printings (standard 1–204, specials 205–242) so the binder can page through the set; fixtureImageSources skips records-only entries, fixtures.ts exposes the flag, and the tests require the 242 printings and no thumbnail for any record. Images stay at 75; catalog:verify matches the snapshot exactly.

Implementation-plan task 5 (standard §17, design screen 3): Binder (one or two faces of 3 x 3 pockets by content fit through a hidden probe sized from tokens, sticky previous and next buttons flanking the faces, a polite page indicator, Go to card number with an explained not-found, Page Up and Page Down scoped to the binder with focus moved to the new spread, only visible faces rendered, a fade with brief travel that reduced motion removes), BinderPocket (owned with normal and foil quantities, missing with silhouette, name and number, unknown and unavailable labelled and never zero, loading, padding and filtered without focus), PocketGrid (Grid view), CompletionSummary (standard denominator, special printings and foils as separate figures) and InspectorLayout (inspection column beside working content). Component tokens binder.pocket-min and binder.go-to; 18 component strings.

stories/support/reference/binder.ts builds the 29 pages (six ink sections and the special printings, each starting on a new page), demonstration holdings on printings with images (24 of 204 standard, 2 of 38 special, 7 foils), filters, pocket states and completion; cards.ts adds hasThumbnail and the deckbuilder catalog now shows only printings with images. Collection.stories.tsx composes the room (set picker in the header, filters and the view switch on one row, completion, binder, Grid and List views, inspection) with stories for every design state plus takedown and unknown ownership.

Seven Collection browser tests in reference.spec.ts. Two defects they found were fixed before the receipt: a keyboard page turn lost focus when the focused pocket unmounted, and an effect declared before its dependency stopped the story rendering. RUN-20261022-023 passes the gates and 290/290 Chromium tests; RUN-20261022-022 passes the fixture tests and catalog:verify.

Visual review at 1440 x 900 and 820 x 1180 found the binder pushed far below the fold and page buttons distant from a single face; the toolbar was compacted, the set picker moved into the header and the buttons now flank the faces and stay in view. Captures are in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/.
Card-catalog runbook and validation (records-only entries), design-system runbook (Collection binder) and validation (task 5).
